components.name: CLI
components.purpose: Human/agent interface for scan, toolchain, audit, and bounded next-finding operations.

components.name: Repository Scanner
components.purpose: Walk repository content deterministically while excluding common generated/dependency directories.

components.name: Language Registry
components.purpose: Map source extensions to language identities without semantic-analysis claims.

components.name: Toolchain Registry
components.purpose: Detect compilers/runtimes and project manifests conservatively.

components.name: Detector Engine
components.purpose: Execute registered deterministic language analyzers and provide stable finding ordering.

components.name: Go Built-in Analyzer
components.purpose: Provide deliberately narrow high-signal M01 rules across the five DoctorCode categories.

components.name: Evidence Reducer
components.purpose: Turn the highest-priority finding into a tokenizer-independent bounded byte packet for small LLMs.

data_flows.meaning: Audit dispatches the visible repository to registered deterministic analyzers.
Go source is parsed and narrow findings are generated with explicit confidence.
The sorted highest-priority finding is reduced to a bounded packet for doctorcode next.
Only finding evidence and a bounded source excerpt are exposed; security excerpts are omitted by default.

external_boundaries.name: GitHub Actions
external_boundaries.contract: Linux, Windows, and macOS hosted runners are acceptance authority.

external_boundaries.name: Host toolchains
external_boundaries.contract: Compiler/runtime availability is observed, never assumed.

external_boundaries.name: Future language analyzers
external_boundaries.contract: Each language declares semantic coverage separately; recognition alone never implies analyzer support.
